instruction: `Store` caches an open handle. It must notice when the underlying store has been replaced — a cleanup, another process — and reopen, rather than keep writing into an orphaned handle. Identity, not path.
provenance: URL shortener change round, 2026-09-16: hexa's adversarial pass found a SQLite adapter validating its connection by path existence. Replacing the store left writes acknowledged and invisible. One competing framework shipped the same fault.
